description: 경기도_휴게음식점(철도역구내) 현황 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도 내 철도역 구내에서 운영되는 휴게음식점에 대한 현황 자료로, 31개 시군의 인허가 정보를 기반으로 수록되어 있습니다. 주요 항목으로는 시군명, 사업장명, 인허가일자, 영업상태, 폐업일자, 소재지 주소 및 면적, 위생업종 및 업태, 총시설규모, 종사자 수(남녀별), 다중이용업소 여부... Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 철도역구내, 휴게음식점, 위생업소, 인허가현황, 식품안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
